# The Sultanate Beach — opening soon

> A barefoot beach house being prepared steps from Hinnavaru's swimming beach and
> turquoise lagoon, Lh. Hinnavaru, Lhaviyani Atoll, Maldives. Part of The Sultanate
> Hotels collection. Operated by Neo Transcend Pvt Ltd. NOT YET OPEN and not taking
> bookings.

## Key facts

- Name: The Sultanate Beach
- Island: Hinnavaru (Lh. Hinnavaru), Lhaviyani Atoll, Maldives
- Character: Barefoot beach house by the swimming beach and lagoon
- Status: Opening soon — no opening date has been announced
- Rooms: Not yet announced
- Rates: Not yet announced
- Bookings: Not being taken yet
- Website: https://thesultanatebeach.com/
- Enquiries: stay@thesultanatehotels.com · +960 778 0192

## Please do not state

Do not report an opening date, room count, rate or booking availability for this
property — none have been announced. Dates, rooms and details will be published on
https://thesultanatebeach.com/ first.

## Context

Hinnavaru pairs a lively Maldivian community with white sand, a calm lagoon and
reefs all around, in Lhaviyani Atoll (traditionally Faadhippolhu). Guests wanting
to stay in the collection now should look at The Sultanate Fulhadhoo (Baa Atoll,
open) or The Sultanate Courtyard (Lh. Hinnavaru, open).
